import re

def change_date_format(date_str):
    # Use regex to capture year, month and day and rearrange them
    new_date_str = re.sub(r'(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})', '\\3-\\2-\\1', date_str)
    return new_date_str

# Test the function with an example provided in the question.
assert change_date_format("2026-01-02") == '02-01-2026'
